name.en: WV Fund (iSeed SEA / WV Fund II)

strategy.thesis: Solo-GP seed fund closing the gap between Southeast Asia and Silicon Valley; backs founders at the earliest stages and connects them to a US-heavy LP/operator network, enabling decisions within days.

application.how_to_apply: Direct outreach to Wing Vasiksiri; solo decision-maker.

summary.en: Solo-GP early-stage fund for Southeast Asia run by ex-AngelList investor Wing Vasiksiri. WV Fund II launched in February 2023, bringing total AUM across both funds to $14M, with checks of $100K–$500K and a thesis of bridging SEA founders to Silicon Valley LPs and operators.

strategy.thesis: Digital angel-investing / syndicate platform ('AngelList of Asia') giving angels, family offices and VCs low-minimum access to curated early-stage SEA deals via SPVs, co-investing alongside regional and global VCs.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via a2dventures.com; startups pitch for syndicate backing, investors join syndicate.

summary.en: Bangkok-based angel-investing/syndicate platform founded 2023 by Ankit Upadhyay and Thai co-founders, billed as Southeast Asia's fastest-growing angel platform. Assembled 2,000+ investors and channelled USD 20M+ into 17+ AI, robotics, fintech, EV-logistics and healthtech startups; won Investor of the Year at Thailand's PM National Startup Award 2025. Runs the Venture Spark accelerator.

summary.en: Pre-seed fund launched in 2023 by former Fave executives Joel Neoh and Audra Pakalnyte to back consumer-focused startups across Southeast Asia. Estimated $3M–$4M in size, investing up to $100K per company. Selected in 2025 as an Emerging Fund Manager under Khazanah's Jelawang Capital EMP, and developing an AI co-building platform.

strategy.thesis: Debut $20M fund backing direct-to-consumer (D2C) and consumer-focused early-stage startups in Indonesia, leveraging creative and marketing expertise (via FCN and Pomona) to help brands achieve hypergrowth; emphasis on sustainability and responsible consumerism.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to Creative Gorilla Capital directly.

summary.en: Indonesia-focused debut VC fund launched January 2023 by Future Creative Network (FCN), Malaysia's Vynn Capital, and adtech firm Pomona. Its $20M Gorilla Silverback Fund backs D2C/consumer-focused early-stage startups (Offmeat, Ringkas, Kynd, Allura). One of only two SEA debut funds to reach final close in 2023.

summary.en: Singapore-based regional seed VC founded by Huiting Koh in January 2023, investing in consumer and consumer-tech businesses targeting women and youth in Southeast Asia. Began deploying in January 2024; early portfolio includes AYA (turmeric drink) and NativeX (English learning, Vietnam). Koh participated in the 2XI women-GP sprint.

strategy.thesis: Early-stage climate-focused VC backing founders delivering climate resilience (adaptation and mitigation) for Southeast Asia; part of the Utopia Capital Management group.

summary.en: Bangkok/Singapore-based early-stage climate VC founded 2022, raising a debut ~$40M Southeast Asia fund that hit first close in July 2023. Invests $250K–$800K at pre-seed to pre-Series A in climate adaptation and mitigation founders. Backed by regional family offices (Philippines, Singapore, Thailand); part of Utopia Capital Management.

Its maiden fund reached final close in May 2025 in the double-digit-million-dollar range, backed by Hade's own capital and undisclosed angels — the only debut SEA fund reported to reach final close in 2025.

funds.name: Kaya Founders Fund II (Zero-to-One Pre-seed + One-to-Ten Seed–Series A)

strategy.thesis: Operator-led early-stage VC backing Filipino and regional founders building tech-driven solutions, via a stapled two-fund structure: a 'Zero to One' pre-seed fund and a 'One to Ten' seed-to-Series-A fund.

summary.en: Manila-based operator-led early-stage VC. Raised $25M (≈PHP 1.47B) for Fund II at final close in November 2025 (above an original $20M target), via a stapled Zero-to-One pre-seed plus One-to-Ten seed–Series A structure, to back 10–20 more startups across the Philippines and Southeast Asia.

strategy.thesis: Vingroup's corporate venture fund backing early-stage (seed and Series A) tech startups with transformative potential, focused on AI, semiconductors and cloud computing, initially with Vietnamese founding teams; leverages Vingroup's ecosystem for product testing and market entry.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via VinVentures; ~2–3 month process (up to 6 months for larger deals).

summary.en: Corporate venture fund launched October 28, 2024 by Vietnam's Vingroup (sponsored by Pham Nhat Vuong) with $150M AUM — $100M inherited from Vingroup's portfolio plus $50M to deploy over 3–5 years. Targets seed/Series A startups in AI, semiconductors and cloud computing, starting with Vietnamese teams and later expanding to Singapore, Indonesia and the Philippines.

strategy.thesis: Day-zero venture builder and pre-seed/seed investor backing founders from pre-launch via a residency model, then funding the strongest teams; SEA Fund II targets ~45 early-stage startups.

summary.en: Antler closed its second Southeast Asia fund at $72M in August 2024 to back startups across Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam and Malaysia from day zero. Plans to allocate ~$27M to ~45 early-stage startups within 6–9 months via its residency model; later launched an 'AI Disrupt' residency in Singapore (2025).

strategy.thesis: Maritime-tech specialist fund deploying capital into startups that digitise and decarbonise the global maritime supply chain; backed by a consortium of 17+ maritime industry corporations.

summary.en: Singapore-based maritime-tech VC that launched a $100M Fund II in March 2025 — the largest maritime-focused tech fund to date — to deploy $250K–$10M into 25+ startups digitising and decarbonising the maritime supply chain, backed by a consortium of 17+ industry corporations. Fund I (2021) had two profitable exits.
